contract.EQUATION_GRADE: Equation, units, assumptions and valid region are explicit; numerical output is regression-testable inside that boundary.
contract.PHYSICAL_APPROXIMATION: Physical equation with intentionally omitted parasitics or modes; numerical values are meaningful only inside the stated approximation.
contract.TEACHING_SURROGATE: Causal comparison model. Do not infer hardware settling time, bandwidth, phase margin or absolute latency.
contract.QUALITATIVE_SIGNATURE: Direction/features only. Axes or normalized traces are not physical measurements.
contract.HARDWARE_EVIDENCE: Claim closes only with board/scope/SFRA or configuration-specific evidence.
contract.MIXED: Page contains more than one fidelity class; each quantitative card must state its own boundary.

modules.model: Buck volt-second balance, CCM ripple and LC/ESR identities
modules.validRegion: declared CCM/ideal-switch assumptions on each calculator
modules.knownBoundary: DCM, switch/diode loss, inductor DCR and digital delay are not universal defaults
modules.action: keep numerical axes tied to equations; do not generalize CCM identities into DCM

modules.model: divider/scaling/ideal ADC quantization
modules.validRegion: declared Vref, divider and ideal quantizer
modules.knownBoundary: ACQPS settling, source impedance, noise, INL/DNL and reference error require device/board data
modules.action: quantization step must never be labeled total measurement accuracy

modules.model: firmware/SPWM/state demonstrations
modules.validRegion: per-card equation or architecture boundary
modules.knownBoundary: rendered PWM/state behavior is not automatically a power-stage plant
modules.action: separate exact timer/modulation identities from topology teaching visuals

modules.model: Clarke/Park identities plus FOC architecture teaching layers
modules.validRegion: transform equations are equation-grade; motor/plant cards only when parameters are explicit
modules.knownBoundary: architecture arrows are not motor dynamics
modules.action: retain explicit distinction between coordinate transforms and machine model

modules.model: PI/discrete controller equations with selected plant surrogates
modules.validRegion: controller arithmetic is exact for stated discretization
modules.knownBoundary: generic first-order response is not the attached power stage
modules.action: label plant surrogate separately from PI implementation

modules.model: SPI frame/bit timing
modules.validRegion: declared clock polarity/phase, word length and clock rate
modules.knownBoundary: GPIO pad delay, DMA/ISR arbitration and board SI require hardware/config evidence
modules.action: keep frame timing numerical; label transport/firmware latency separately

modules.model: sample-compute-commit timing plus control response teaching models
modules.validRegion: event timing is equation-grade when scheduler assumptions are explicit
modules.knownBoundary: generic response curves must not imply real LC settling
modules.action: tie missed-load events to strict PWM load deadlines

modules.model: BMS/C2000 architecture and state-flow demonstrations
modules.validRegion: state/logic paths are deterministic where encoded
modules.knownBoundary: cell/pack electrochemistry and fault latency are not implied by UI timing
modules.action: keep state-machine truth separate from battery-physics truth

modules.model: DAC code-to-output mapping and interface timing
modules.validRegion: ideal transfer with declared reference/gain chain
modules.knownBoundary: settling, glitch impulse, op-amp dynamics and startup state require datasheet/board evidence
modules.action: do not equate ideal code step with settled analog accuracy

modules.model: AFE gain/filter/sensing teaching models
modules.validRegion: declared ideal op-amp/filter equations
modules.knownBoundary: GBW, slew, common-mode, noise, tolerance and ADC loading can invalidate ideal response
modules.action: each analog graph must expose component values and omitted nonidealities

modules.model: average-current-mode/PFC control architecture and selected equations
modules.validRegion: per-loop model boundary
modules.knownBoundary: whole-converter behavior is not one generic transfer function
modules.action: separate current plant, voltage plant, line-cycle disturbance and digital delay

modules.model: DDS phase accumulator and waveform synthesis identities
modules.validRegion: declared accumulator width, sample rate and LUT/interpolation policy
modules.knownBoundary: DAC reconstruction, jitter, quantization spurs and analog filtering require separate model
modules.action: keep phase/frequency arithmetic equation-grade; label spectral hardware effects

modules.model: slew-rate and finite-bandwidth op-amp dynamic models
modules.validRegion: declared single-pole/SR assumptions and rail limits
modules.knownBoundary: real macro-model poles, output current, CMRR/PSRR and recovery vary by device
modules.action: continue regression against analytical SR/GBW boundaries

modules.model: synchronization/SPLL signal-flow and transform models
modules.validRegion: declared discrete equations and signal assumptions
modules.knownBoundary: grid distortion, sampling delay and coefficient quantization alter closed-loop behavior
modules.action: separate exact transforms from PLL plant/lock-time surrogates

modules.model: protection authority/state logic plus configurable comparator/filter paths
modules.validRegion: logic truth is deterministic; latency is configuration/device/gate specific
modules.knownBoundary: no universal fixed fault-to-gate microseconds
modules.action: require CMPSS/XBAR/TZ configuration and scope measurement for absolute latency

modules.model: synthetic diagnosis challenge bank
modules.validRegion: deterministic case-bank logic
modules.knownBoundary: candidate elimination is not a measured Bayesian fault probability
modules.action: keep Module 19 as authoritative executable/board-evidence capstone

modules.model: Fourier/Laplace/Z/coordinate-transform identities plus control interpretation
modules.validRegion: mathematical identities are equation-grade
modules.knownBoundary: illustrative signal animations do not create plant-specific dynamics
modules.action: axes/domains must explicitly distinguish continuous, discrete and normalized variables

modules.model: Buck/Boost/PFC/PSFB/LLC/Inverter topology plants
modules.validRegion: each topology section declares its equation-grade averaged/FHA boundary
modules.knownBoundary: parasitics, mode transitions, digital delay and hardware evidence remain outside ideal plants
modules.action: quantitative visual ownership lives in assets/learning/model-contracts-v1.json

modules.model: unified control grammar plus equation-backed sampled-data engineering workbench
modules.validRegion: architecture cards are causal mappings; workbench numerics inherit explicit model contracts and timing assumptions
modules.knownBoundary: unified diagrams do not replace topology-specific G(s); imported measurements do not become hardware evidence without provenance
modules.action: connect plant, controller, ZOH/delay, PWM commit and measurement without duplicating model contracts

modules.model: authoritative executable Buck firmware capstone, timing/SIL/board evidence contracts
modules.validRegion: host SIL and deterministic firmware models are executable; board claims are evidence-gated
modules.knownBoundary: physical-board behavior remains UNCLAIMED without bound evidence
modules.action: preserve fail-closed board-claim and exact sample→actuate timing semantics
